Put a frame in comparison normal form

Source: R/verify.R
md_normal_form.Rd

Removes the differences that carry no information, so the ones that remain are unambiguously behavioural:

Usage

md_normal_form(d, columns, key = c("ein", "name_key", "street_key", "zip5"))

Arguments

d

A data frame.

columns

Character vector of columns to compare. Required — passing the live field set is the mistake this argument exists to prevent.

key

Columns identifying a row. Default the reference-frame key.

Value

d in normal form, with a .occ column disambiguating rows that share a key (so duplicates are compared as a multiset rather than collapsed).

Details

  1. restrict to columns — the pinned list from the 0a baseline manifest, never npmatch::np_fields resolved at run time (Phase 0c adds variant_class to it, so a live lookup would compare a baseline built without that column against a candidate built with it)

  2. coerce every comparison column to character, and "" to NA

  3. order rows by key, dropping incidental row order

  4. order columns by name
